escape_regex_flags: escape regex flags from a compiled pattern object to a string representation
escape_for_regex: escape special regex characters in a plain text string for safe regex use
escape_regex_for_selector: escape a regex pattern for use inside a Playwright text selector
escape_for_text_selector: escape a string or regex pattern for use in a Playwright text selector
escape_for_attribute_selector: escape a string or regex pattern for use in a Playwright attribute selector
